---
title: "About"
---

This project is part of Guillermo Garcia Costoya's research on
natural selection in *Anolis* lizards, advised by James Stroud.
Fieldwork took place on Lizard Island.

The source code for this site, the cleaned data and the analysis
scripts are in the
[GitHub repository](https://github.com/ggcostoya/morph-perf-surv-lizard-island).
